eyebrow: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform · Chapter 4
subtitle: Lesson 17 · Modules & Reuse

eyebrow: From a repeated resource block to a module
code:
# modules/storage-account/main.tf
resource "azurerm_storage_account" "this" {
  name                     = "stnbretail${var.environment}"
  resource_group_name      = var.resource_group_name
  location                 = var.location
  account_tier             = "Standard"
  account_replication_type = var.replication_type
}
caption: A module is just a folder of .tf files -- this one happens to be parameterized.

code:
module "storage_dev" {
  source              = "./modules/storage-account"
  environment         = "dev"
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.dev.name
  location            = "eastus2"
  replication_type    = "LRS"
}

module "storage_staging" {
  source              = "./modules/storage-account"
  environment         = "staging"
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.staging.name
  location            = "eastus2"
  replication_type    = "LRS"
}
caption: Same main.tf, two independent instances -- module.storage_dev and module.storage_staging.
